description_en: This API converts a natural language description into an executable SQL statement by retrieving relevant database and business information
description_zh: 调用该API可根据用户提供的自然语言描述，自动获取相关数据库与业务信息并生成可执行的SQL语句

name: GenerateSqlFromNL

parameters.help_en:
The database ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html operation to obtain this ID.

The API operation uses the schema from this database to generate the SQL statement
parameters.help_zh:
数据库ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html接口获取该参数的值。

调用API时，系统将会在该数据库中获取相关信息
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en: Supplementary business information to help the model better understand the question
parameters.help_zh: 知识数据，即额外输入的业务知识。补充的知识可以帮助模型更好地理解、回答问题
parameters.name: knowledge

parameters.example: 查询今天的用户访问量
parameters.help_en: The natural language question to convert into an SQL statement
parameters.name: question

parameters.help_en: The SQL dialect. If unspecified, the system defaults to `MySQL` and generates a standard SQL statement
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例类型。系统默认值为MySQL，将为您生成标准的SQL语句
parameters.name: dialect

parameters.help_en: The processing level. The default value is `base`
parameters.help_zh: 数据处理级别。默认为基础级别的处理
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: The Qwen series model to use
parameters.help_zh: 选用的模型名称，仅可使用通义千问系列的模型
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: A comma-separated list of table names. If specified, the model uses only these tables to generate the SQL statement
parameters.help_zh: 选用的表名，列表（用逗号分隔），若指定该值，则只会使用选用的表
parameters.name: table_names

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the user who calls the operation
parameters.help_zh: 实际调用 API 的用户的阿里云账号 UID
parameters.name: real_login_user_uid
